about: Sonic: acoustic intelligence; a measured, tagged sound catalog and an event -> sound picker

caps.does: measure and tag every sound file, write the catalog (cached: unchanged files are not decoded again)
find sounds by tags and measurements, e.g. material=steel action=impact dur<0.5
choose a sound for each event of an aethern-event file and say when it starts; writes sonic.pick events
one synthesized footstep per foot contact, shaped by surface, footwear, weight, speed, distance and room; writes sonic.step events
caps.args: STEPS.jsonl [--surface sand|earth|grass|wood|stone|metal|water] [--footwear bare|soft|sandal|geta|boot] [--weight KG] [--room open|room|hall] [--out F]
